Works to reduce lead and mercury pollution, including lead in cosmetics and spices. GiveWell and Happier Lives Institute published 3 public models of its work; the most recent, from July 2021, puts it at **6.9× GiveDirectly (GW: 18× cash)**.

GiveWell states results as multiples of its cash benchmark. GiveDirectly itself scores about 2.6× that benchmark in GiveWell's own model, so GiveWell's multiples look 2.6 times smaller here, where everything is compared with GiveDirectly.

| Model | By | Date | Result | Cells reproduced |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Pure Earth BOTEC](/pure-earth) | GW | July 2021 | 6.9× GiveDirectly (GW: 18× cash) | 77, 2 kept fixed |
| [Pure Earth: leaded cosmetics advocacy in Ghana (HLI, July 2025 correction)](/pure-earth/pure-earth-hli-ghana-cosmetics) | HLI | July 2025 | 14× GiveDirectly | 27 |
| [Pure Earth: leaded cosmetics advocacy in Ghana (HLI, before the July 2025 correction)](/pure-earth/pure-earth-hli-ghana-cosmetics-before-correction) | HLI | November 2024 | 14× GiveDirectly | 25 |
